name: use-forms
title: useQuestionnaire
description: useQuestionnaire: the forms block's controllers as React hooks, for React DOM and React Native.
docs: Needs the forms block (`npx better-supabase add forms`), `lib/supabase/blocks.generated.ts` from `npx better-supabase gen`, and a `BetterSupabaseProvider` above the component. See https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/forms.
